listing.name: Salvage Magnet
listing.summary: The new salvage ability salvages all debris within reach instead of one at a time. Interacting with a derelict includes all derelicts within reach inside the salvage dialog.
listing.aiSummary: Salvages all debris within reach simultaneously instead of one at a time.

description:
Salvage Magnet

I can't believe this is not in the base game!

The new salvage ability salvages all debris within reach instead of one at a time. Interacting with a derelict includes all derelicts within reach inside the salvage dialog.

Still in Beta. Some bugs need to be ironed.

Compatibility

Can be added mid-save
Cannot be removed mid-save
It is mentioned when releases are not compatible with previous ones

Credits

rolfosian - made the entire mod.
WolframSegler - maintainer.
